header.title: Rate metrics
state.denied: The usage domain is denied: declare "usage" in plugin.json privacy and reinstall the plugin.
range.title: Range
range.invalid: Pick a valid range: the start date cannot be later than the end date.
hint.noPeaks: Ranges over 36 hours do not compute minute peaks.
hint.truncated: More than {{n}} records: peaks are a lower bound of the fetched records.
footer.note: Range averages are normalized by the selected span; values are booked at request completion and exclude other clients on the same key.
